## 3. DESCRIPTION (Final Public Copy — Plain Text)
The desk hums quietly as systems run in the background.
A CRT monitor anchors the space, terminal text scrolling with steady purpose. Tape decks rest beside the keyboard, LEDs glow softly on aging hardware, and the warm desk lamp gives everything a grounded, familiar weight. Nothing flashy — just pure atmosphere built for long, uninterrupted focus.
This 3-hour LoFi + Synthwave mix is designed for coding, studying, writing, and extended deep work sessions. Calm, consistent energy that stays present without distraction.
All music is royalty-free and safe for content creators.

Retro CRT coding desk • centered CRT with readable terminal/program output • warm desk lamp lighting • rich analog gear (cassette deck, reel-to-reel, synths) • plants • posters • cinematic angle • window with subtle skyline • high thumbnail clarity • slightly stylized, mature atmosphere
### AI Prompt
Cinematic retro 80s–90s analog coding desk with a large CRT monitor centered, displaying crisp scrolling terminal text or program output in green or teal. Desk densely detailed with mechanical keyboard, notebooks, floppy disks, cassette tapes, cables, vintage mouse, and subtle clutter. Surrounding gear includes a cassette deck, small analog synth, vintage speakers, and optionally a reel-to-reel recorder. Warm desk lamp casting amber light across the surface. Several plants integrated naturally into the scene. A window behind the desk shows a subtle city skyline at dusk or neutral night with soft ambient glow. Posters and tech ephemera on the wall. High clarity, sharp focus, cinematic composition, slight stylization (not photorealistic, not childish), no empty space, no blur, no glare.
